entries.title: Log Viewer
entries.limitations: Bounded stdout/stderr with search, stream filter, copy and export; private worker source paths are not exposed.

entries.title: Artifact Browser
entries.limitations: Captured path/name/caption records resolve immutable saved bundle members only; external and newly generated non-bundled files are unavailable.

entries.title: Result Inspector
entries.limitations: Captured Inspect/Pretty, literal Find and table controls; search covers bounded snapshots, not the worker heap.

entries.title: Data Table
entries.limitations: Runtime renderer present; this inventory does not assert equality of every inspector option.

entries.title: Task Monitor
entries.limitations: Up to 512 task records, parent tree, state/errors, duration and usage; only trusted cell/line references, never private worker paths.

entries.title: Run History
entries.limitations: Shared server retention/pins; scalar restore is atomic per scope, not a whole local notebook heap.

entries.title: Experiment Compare
entries.limitations: Exact scalar/metric deltas and CSV; same retained-snapshot limits as Run History.
